source: Shul dues schedules, camp fee tables, kosher grocery pricing and the running costs Modern Orthodox families report, gathered in summer 2026 and rounded to bands per family.
confidenceNote: These are starting points for a family that has not added up its own year. Each one is an input the family replaces. The month is the civil month the cost usually lands in; the Hebrew calendar drifts, so a Tishrei that starts in September one year starts in October the next.

events.label: Shul membership
events.note: Full family dues. Many shuls bill in Elul, before Rosh Hashanah. A younger or single membership costs less.

events.label: High Holiday seats
events.note: Often included in membership. Type zero if yours are.

events.label: Sukkot: lulav, etrog, the sukkah
events.note: One lulav and etrog set is roughly a hundred dollars; schach and a sukkah are a one-time buy that come round again when they wear out.

events.label: Tishrei meals and guests
events.note: Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur break-fast, Sukkot, Shemini Atzeret and Simchat Torah: nine yom tov meals on top of the usual Shabbat.

events.label: Chanukah
events.note: Candles, oil, gifts, latkes and a party.

events.label: Purim
events.note: Mishloach manot, matanot l'evyonim, the seudah, costumes.

events.label: Pesach at home
events.note: The extra over an ordinary month: kosher for Pesach food, matzah, wine, and the things the kitchen needs. A hotel program is a separate line; type it here if you go.

events.label: Shavuot
events.note: Two days of meals, the dairy kind.

events.label: Mikvah
events.note: Many mikvaot ask a yearly membership or a fee per visit. Type zero if it does not apply.

events.label: Eruv and community dues
events.note: The eruv, the vaad, the chevra kadisha: the small yearly asks.

events.label: Israel trip
events.note: A family trip, when there is one. Leave it empty if there is none this year.

weekly.label: The Shabbat table
weekly.note: What Shabbat adds each week over ordinary weekday eating: challah, wine, meat or chicken, dessert, and the guests. Kosher meat runs at roughly one and a half to two times the ordinary price.

sleepaway.label: Sleepaway camp
sleepaway.note: Four to eight weeks. A deposit is usually due in the winter; the balance in the spring or at the start of June.

day.label: Day camp
day.note: A full summer of day camp for a younger child.
